body:
Addition by the maintainer, 2026-11-16:

> "outside machining like that should be entering from the inside and work up to the selected face or edge.."

This replaces the "Expected" paragraph of the issue body. The body said that the tool starts outside the selected area. The maintainer's words are the requirement:

- The tool enters from the inside of the area that the operation machines.
- The passes then move toward the selected face or edge.
- The selected face or edge is the limit where the passes stop.

Open point for the worker: record in the decision file which region "the inside" is for outside containment (the region between the stock side and the selected boundary), and where in that region the entry goes. Quote the maintainer's words there.

Done means, in addition: the test shows that the first cut is at the entry in that region and that the last pass is at the selected face or edge.

claimed: vilts (Claude Code session) · 2026-11-16T19:34Z · worktree/branch vilts:issue/2232-adaptive-outside-entry · plan: find where the Adaptive entry search reads the containment, and enter for outside containment from inside the region between the stock side and the selected boundary, with the passes moving out to the selected face.

Findings before code. A decision is necessary.

## Readings

Probe: `fig8.step`, stock 5 mm past the part on each side, tool `EM-1000-4FL` (10 mm), 2D Adaptive, containment Outside.

| Selected face | Extension | Result |
|---|---|---|
| bottom face, Z 0 (the part stands on it) | 0 | `adaptive: the center area has no room for an entry` |
| bottom face, Z 0 | 4 mm | generates; note `a piece of the area has no entry room - left uncut`; worst planned load 81.6 % of D |
| top face, Z 20 | 0 or 4 mm | generates; the HSM plan is refused as a channel, and Offset rings cut it |

## Cause

The entry search is not the cause. The cause is the area law (`crates/app/src/operation/boundary.rs`, step 5).

- For a clearing kind, containment Outside grows the outline of the selection by one tool diameter, then removes the part (`containment_delta(ToolInside, Outside, r)` = 2r, `reach_past_edge`).
- The generator keeps the full tool inside that area. Thus the tool center has a line of zero width, and no entry fits.
- `crates/app/tests/shoulder_adaptive.rs` (`containment_outside_clears_past_the_edge_never_the_recess`) pins this refusal as correct behaviour today.

## The decision

The requirement says: "entering from the inside and work up to the selected face or edge". This needs an area that is wider than the tool. Two options:

1. **Area out to the stock.** With a stock, containment Outside on a clearing kind clears from the selected face out to the stock outline. The area goes one tool radius past the stock, so the outer passes run in air. The law already uses this rule for an open boundary. The entry is in the free area away from the face, and the last pass is at the face. Without a stock, the band of today stays, and the refusal names the Extension control.
   - This changes the posted G-code of each clearing kind (Pocket, Adaptive and the others), not only 2D Adaptive.
   - The pinned refusal in `shoulder_adaptive` becomes a generated toolpath.
   - The work is probably `effort:max`.
2. **Refusal by name only.** Keep the band of one tool. Replace the message with a refusal that names the control, for example: "containment Outside leaves a band one tool wide around the selection - set an Extension (Boundary page) to give the tool room past the edge". This is small and safe. It does not meet the addition of 2026-11-16 (enter inside, work up to the face).

Recommendation: option 1, because it meets the requirement of the maintainer. Please select an option. The claim stays. No code is written until an option is selected.

claimed: Antigravity (len) · 2026-11-16T20:20:54Z · branch mkinney:issue/2232-adaptive-outside-entry · plan: include stock outside a selected boundary under Outside containment, enter inside that region, and work toward the selected boundary

Addition by the maintainer in chat, 2026-11-16 (reported again as a bug):

> "2D Adaptive; Does not understand how to "clear" bulk material from outside of a model up to outer selected edge. Planning for bulk removal using an adaptive strategy.. Containment "outside" states "Center area has no room for entry" which makes no sense if its going to clear from outside in.."

Reading of the orchestrator session (not the maintainer's words): this agrees with option 1 of the findings comment. Containment Outside on 2D Adaptive clears the bulk material between the stock outline and the selected outer edge. The band of one tool diameter does not meet this. Option 2 (a better refusal only) does not meet it.

Notes:

- The maintainer did not select an option by number. If the reading is wrong, he corrects it here.
- The change is under the safety floor: it changes posted G-code of the clearing kinds. The verify check and the post gate stay unchanged.
- Two claims are live on this issue (`vilts`, 2026-11-16T19:34Z; `mkinney`, 2026-11-16T20:20Z). The first claim holds the issue. The two claimants must agree who does the work.

Decision of the maintainer in chat, 2026-11-16:

> "Decision on 2232; Option1.."

Option 1 of the findings comment is selected: with a stock, containment Outside on a clearing kind clears from the selected face or edge out to the stock outline. The entry is in the free area away from the face. The last pass is at the face.

Conditions that stay:

- The verify check and the post gate do not change.
- An entry or a pass in the air band past the stock must not go through a fixture.
- The PR names each golden that changes and says that no real control run was made.
- The pinned refusal in `crates/app/tests/shoulder_adaptive.rs` becomes a generated toolpath. The PR says so.
Claim withdrawn by vilts. @mkinney does the work of option 1. The findings comment above stays as input. No branch or code was made on my side.
